title: Huge cell text docx 001
notes: real huge single-string text (not an image or overflow hack): one paragraph holding the deterministic 60,000-char string 'lorem ipsum ' * 5000 in a single w:t run, plus a 3x2 Table Grid table whose cell(1,1) holds 'lorem ipsum ' * 834 (10,008 chars); other cells are short r{r}c{c} markers. Reference text is the exact same strings, byte-for-byte as inserted. The repetitive lorem would compress hard, but the normalized container is STORED for cross-environment byte determinism (INV-4): saved blob is 899224 bytes, far under the 10 MB cap. Overflow/wrap/pagination behavior at render time is the fixture's point.
